Builders in Ilford

Ilford

Local Builders You Can Trust

Ilford's Edwardian terraces stretch across Seven Kings, Goodmayes and the streets around Valentines Park, with plenty of 1920s and 1930s houses mixed in. Many of these homes have been extended or altered over the years, and a good number now need bringing up to date. We take on renovations, extensions, kitchens and bathrooms, and the plastering and decorating to finish them properly.

Building Work We Take On in Ilford

  • Rear extensions on Edwardian terraces
  • Full renovations
  • Kitchen and bathroom fitting
  • Rendering and external repairs

Why Choose B Lala Construction in Ilford?

We bring 27 years' experience to every job and handle the building work and the finishing trades ourselves, so you deal with one team from start to finish. Every job starts with a free quote, and we are based close by in Walthamstow.
